rules.observation: One country, indicator and calendar year.
rules.latest: The latest numeric observation is selected independently for each indicator and its year is retained.
rules.missingness: Null, absent and non-numeric observations remain unavailable; no interpolation or zero filling is permitted.
rules.scope: OECD-only utilisation and avoidable-mortality indicators are enrichments, not requirements for global baseline completeness.
rules.processing: Bulk retrieval and production transforms run in Google Cloud. Local runs use small fixtures or already-pinned raw inputs.
